1.title: AGI Was Achieved in February 2026 | Bernardo Aceituno
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Open-weight models now cost-competitive and governance-compliant for 90% of enterprise workloads; remaining gaps in visual understanding, memory systems, and benchmark reliability; interview with StackAI co-founder on enterprise AI adoption shift.

2.title: Anthropic Sees Imminent RSI Acceleration | Herbie Bradley
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Herbie Bradley discusses Anthropic's S-1 filing on RSI (reasoning-to-superintelligence) acceleration timelines, critiques fast-takeoff narratives, and analyzes why enterprise AI adoption stalls on organizational bottlenecks rather than capability gaps.

1.title: Люксембург. Самые богатые в мире. Почему?
1.author: Послезавтра
1.hook: Economic analysis of Luxembourg's wealth — tax haven status, investment flows, and cost of living — framed as a geopolitical/economic explainer.

1.title: AI Lets Amateurs Find Critical Zero-Days in Hours | Max Justicz
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Security researcher demonstrates using frontier AI models (Daybreak Blue, GLM 5.3) to discover zero-day vulnerabilities in apt and Android in hours; discusses implications for vulnerability disclosure timelines, package maintainer response, and the erosion of hacker skill barriers.

1.title: How To Build The Future: Paul Graham & Amjad Masad
1.author: Y Combinator
1.hook: Amjad Masad on how Replit positioned itself for coding agents (agent architecture, user-obsessed product design), why enterprises adopt it ($10M projects → $250K), and the shift from "vibe coding" to deterministic agent workflows; includes first-hand account of shipping an agent that "barely worked" and the vision for "self-driving companies."

1.title: AI Swarms Won’t Cause Explosive Growth | Alex Imas
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Alex Imas (Google DeepMind) argues that AI capability growth won't drive explosive GDP growth because competitive markets compress output prices, firms operate as distributed intelligence systems, and labor shifts into new high-wage work rather than disappearing.
